steps.name: Obtain TIN
steps.description: Register for taxpayer identification with the relevant Ministry of Revenues/sub-city tax office.
steps.painPoint: May require in-person presence and biometrics.

steps.name: Reserve trade name
steps.description: Reserve the proposed business name through MoTRI/eTrade or the relevant business registration service.
steps.painPoint: Name conflicts or portal downtime can delay progress.

steps.name: Choose legal structure
steps.description: Decide whether the business will operate as a sole proprietorship, PLC, or another permitted form.
steps.painPoint: The choice changes capital, document, and liability requirements.

steps.name: Draft MoA and AoA if forming a PLC
steps.description: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association for a PLC pathway.
steps.painPoint: PLC-only step; sole proprietor skips this.

steps.name: Secure suitable restaurant/bar premises
steps.description: Secure premises suitable for food service, customer seating, kitchen/bar operation, utilities, and local suitability checks.
steps.painPoint: Lease terms and landlord documentation may become bottlenecks.

steps.name: Authenticate lease agreement
steps.description: Authenticate the business premises lease so it can support registration/licensing.
steps.painPoint: Landlord title/authority documents may be required.

steps.name: Authenticate MoA and AoA if PLC
steps.description: Authenticate company constitutional documents for the PLC pathway.
steps.painPoint: Conditional PLC step; shareholders may need to appear.

steps.name: Open blocked capital account if PLC
steps.description: Open a blocked capital account and obtain bank confirmation where required.
steps.painPoint: Bank requirements may vary by institution.

steps.name: Fit out kitchen, bar, sanitation, and customer areas
steps.description: Prepare the premises for food safety, hygiene, ventilation, refrigeration, toilets, water, and waste requirements.
steps.painPoint: Design mistakes can cause failed inspections and costly rework.

steps.name: Obtain staff health certificates
steps.description: Obtain health clearance for food handlers and relevant staff before inspection/operation.
steps.painPoint: Validity period and accepted clinics must be verified.

steps.name: Undergo food-service premises inspection and receive CoC
steps.description: Complete AAFDA/sub-city food-service inspection and obtain the competency/clearance required for licensing.
steps.painPoint: Inspection interpretation may vary by sub-city and inspector.

steps.name: Confirm alcohol service endorsement or restriction

steps.painPoint: Needs local verification by sub-city and exact business code.

steps.name: Publish PLC formation notice if required

steps.painPoint: Verify whether this is still required for the exact company form.

steps.name: Submit commercial registration application
steps.description: Submit registration package to Addis Ababa Trade Bureau or relevant registration office.
steps.painPoint: Incomplete document packets can force repeat visits.

steps.name: Receive commercial registration certificate
steps.description: Receive the certificate confirming the legal existence of the business.
steps.painPoint: Certificate issuance depends on accepted registration package.

steps.name: Apply for trade/business license
steps.description: Apply for the final trade or business license using registration and competency/supporting documents.
steps.painPoint: Competency certificate and registration documents must be aligned with the business code.

steps.name: Receive trade/business license
steps.description: Receive the final license authorizing business operation.
steps.painPoint: License renewal and amendments must be tracked after launch.

steps.name: Unblock and activate business bank account if PLC
steps.description: Convert the blocked account into an operating account after licensing/registration requirements are met.
steps.painPoint: Bank may request license, registration certificate, and tax documents.

steps.name: Register for VAT or TOT / confirm tax account
steps.description: Register or confirm the appropriate tax category and filing account with the tax authority.
steps.painPoint: The correct tax path depends on turnover, sector, and current tax rules.

steps.name: Set up approved receipt, invoicing, or fiscal compliance method
steps.description: Install or activate the approved receipt/invoicing/fiscal compliance method required for legal receipts.
steps.painPoint: Current fiscal/e-invoicing path should be verified for each business type.

steps.name: Hire staff and issue employment contracts

steps.painPoint: Can be parallel but must align with labor and pension obligations.

steps.name: Register employer and employees with POESSA
steps.description: Register the employer and eligible employees with the pension/social security system.
steps.painPoint: Often missed until after hiring begins; verify deadline and portal path.

steps.name: Begin operations and maintain compliance

steps.painPoint: Post-launch compliance should be tracked as part of the journey, not treated as separate.

steps.painPoint: Often missed until after hiring begins; verify deadline and portal path.

steps.name: Begin operations and maintain compliance
steps.description: Begin operations and maintain license renewals, tax filings, employee obligations, and sector compliance.
steps.painPoint: Post-launch compliance should be tracked as part of the journey, not treated as separate.

steps.name: Obtain Fayda or ensure Fayda authentication is available
steps.description: Secure or confirm Fayda identity/authentication readiness before using identity-linked services.
steps.painPoint: Confirm exactly where Fayda is enforced in the current service path.

steps.name: Obtain TIN
steps.description: Register for taxpayer identification with the relevant Ministry of Revenues/sub-city tax office.
steps.painPoint: May require in-person presence and biometrics.

steps.name: Reserve trade name
steps.description: Reserve the proposed business name through MoTRI/eTrade or the relevant business registration service.
steps.painPoint: Name conflicts or portal downtime can delay progress.

steps.name: Choose legal structure
steps.description: Decide whether the business will operate as a sole proprietorship, PLC, or another permitted form.
steps.painPoint: The choice changes capital, document, and liability requirements.

steps.name: Draft MoA and AoA if forming a PLC
steps.description: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association for a PLC pathway.
steps.painPoint: PLC-only step; sole proprietor skips this.

steps.name: Secure tour operator office
steps.description: Secure an office address suitable for tour operator registration, booking, and client service.
steps.painPoint: Lease terms and landlord documentation may become bottlenecks.

steps.name: Authenticate lease agreement
steps.description: Authenticate the business premises lease so it can support registration/licensing.
steps.painPoint: Landlord title/authority documents may be required.

steps.name: Authenticate MoA and AoA if PLC
steps.description: Authenticate company constitutional documents for the PLC pathway.
steps.painPoint: Conditional PLC step; shareholders may need to appear.

steps.name: Open blocked capital account if PLC
steps.description: Open a blocked capital account and obtain bank confirmation where required.
steps.painPoint: Bank requirements may vary by institution.

steps.name: Define tour operator service scope
steps.description: Define local/inbound/outbound tour services, guides, vehicles, routes, and package types.
steps.painPoint: Requirements vary by operator category.

steps.name: Compile vehicle and insurance evidence
steps.description: Prepare evidence for required vehicles and insurance if applicable to tour operator certification.
steps.painPoint: Vehicle class and insurance requirements must be verified against current service instructions.

steps.name: Apply for tourism competency certificate
steps.description: Apply for tour operator/tourism service competency certificate through the tourism authority or eServices path.
steps.painPoint: City/federal role split must be verified.

steps.name: Verify tour guide competency where guides are employed
steps.description: Confirm tour guide competency/certification where the business employs or contracts tour guides.
steps.painPoint: Guide requirements depend on service model.

steps.name: Publish PLC formation notice if required
steps.description: Publish company formation notice if the current PLC pathway requires public notice.
steps.painPoint: Verify whether this is still required for the exact company form.

steps.name: Submit commercial registration application
steps.description: Submit registration package to Addis Ababa Trade Bureau or relevant registration office.
steps.painPoint: Incomplete document packets can force repeat visits.

steps.name: Receive commercial registration certificate
steps.description: Receive the certificate confirming the legal existence of the business.
steps.painPoint: Certificate issuance depends on accepted registration package.

steps.name: Apply for trade/business license
steps.description: Apply for the final trade or business license using registration and competency/supporting documents.
steps.painPoint: Competency certificate and registration documents must be aligned with the business code.

steps.name: Receive trade/business license
steps.description: Receive the final license authorizing business operation.
steps.painPoint: License renewal and amendments must be tracked after launch.

steps.name: Unblock and activate business bank account if PLC
steps.description: Convert the blocked account into an operating account after licensing/registration requirements are met.
steps.painPoint: Bank may request license, registration certificate, and tax documents.

steps.name: Register for VAT or TOT / confirm tax account
steps.description: Register or confirm the appropriate tax category and filing account with the tax authority.
steps.painPoint: The correct tax path depends on turnover, sector, and current tax rules.

steps.name: Set up approved receipt, invoicing, or fiscal compliance method
steps.description: Install or activate the approved receipt/invoicing/fiscal compliance method required for legal receipts.
steps.painPoint: Current fiscal/e-invoicing path should be verified for each business type.

steps.name: Hire staff and issue employment contracts
steps.description: Hire staff and prepare written contracts, job descriptions, payroll records, and HR files.
steps.painPoint: Can be parallel but must align with labor and pension obligations.

steps.name: Register employer and employees with POESSA
steps.description: Register the employer and eligible employees with the pension/social security system.
steps.painPoint: Often missed until after hiring begins; verify deadline and portal path.

steps.name: Begin operations and maintain compliance
steps.description: Begin operations and maintain license renewals, tax filings, employee obligations, and sector compliance.
steps.painPoint: Post-launch compliance should be tracked as part of the journey, not treated as separate.
